title: TRICARE Select Installment, Delinquency and Fee Credit Terms
content:
For a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment the installment frequencies, accepted payment methods, due day, grace period, delinquency letter day, reinstatement request window, credit-earning exit reasons and refund timing are fixed per tier. The four TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers are fee-exempt, so none of these terms applies to them (shown as "not applicable" or 0).

## Terms by tier

The first four columns are the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers (for example, "Group A (E-1 to E-4)" is TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)); the last two are TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

| | Group A (E-1 to E-4) | Group A (E-5 and Above) | Group B (E-1 to E-4) | Group B (E-5 and Above) | Retiree Group A | Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Installment frequencies allowed | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | annual, quarterly, monthly | annual, quarterly, monthly |
| Methods accepted for monthly installments | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card |
| Methods accepted for annual and quarterly installments | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card, single card payment, check | allotment, electronic funds transfer, recurring card, single card payment, check |
| Due day of each installment | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | first day of the installment period | first day of the installment period |
| Grace period before nonpayment disenrollment (calendar days after the due date) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 |
| Delinquency letter issued on (calendar day after the due date) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 10 |
| Window to file an Enrollment Reinstatement Review (calendar days after a nonpayment disenrollment) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 90 | 90 |
| Exit reasons that earn a proration credit of prepaid fees | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | beneficiary disenrollment, loss of eligibility, region transfer, death of the beneficiary | beneficiary disenrollment, loss of eligibility, region transfer, death of the beneficiary |
| Refund of a credit balance issued within (calendar days after it arises) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 30 |

## Reading the terms (hypothetical dates)

- A retiree quarterly installment for the quarter starting 2026-04-01 is due on 2026-04-01, the first day of the period it covers; a delinquency letter for it, if still unpaid, is issued on 2026-04-11, the 10th day after the due date.
- The single card payment and the check are accepted only for annual and quarterly installments; monthly installments are paid by allotment, electronic funds transfer or recurring card.
- A credit balance that arises on a hypothetical 2026-06-05 is refunded within 30 calendar days.
